claims.text: The FDA zonisamide label says coadministration with alcohol has not been evaluated in clinical studies.
claims.quote: Concomitant administration of zonisamide and alcohol or other CNS depressant drugs has not been evaluated in clinical studies.

headline.text: The FDA label says zonisamide and alcohol coadministration has not been evaluated in clinical studies.

reported.text: The label identifies a lack of clinical coadministration studies.

gaps.text: The packet includes animal interaction studies and an alcohol-dependence treatment trial, but no controlled human acute interaction study.
searched: (ethanol[tiab] OR alcohol[tiab]) AND "zonisamide"[tiab] AND (interaction OR coadministration)
